headline: EU will not lift Russia sanctions until war ends
dek: 'We will not lift any sanctions until Russia stops the war.' EC rules out resuming Russian gas purchases because Russia 'could use gas as a weapon at any moment.'
sources: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, address to European Parliament, Strasbourg
fault_line: Hold-the-line solidarity, or sanctions hypocrisy: record Russian LNG flowing into Europe while Brussels vows 'no relief' and Washington does a diesel deal?

sections.what_happened: 'We will not lift any sanctions until Russia stops the war.' EC rules out resuming Russian gas purchases because Russia 'could use gas as a weapon at any moment.'
sections.what_verified: Direct quote from EC President at EP session (APA relay).
sections.what_disputed: EU imported record ~12Mt Russian LNG Jan-Sep 2026 (per Foreign Affairs Forum analysis today); US Treasury suspended Russian diesel penalties until April 2027 — sanctions solidarity vs energy reality.
sections.why_matters: The hypocrisy fault line: von der Leyen vows never to lift sanctions and never buy Russian gas — while EU terminals quietly received record Russian LNG this year and the US waived its own penalties. Pocketbook-first: what this costs European households.
sections.context: Background: EU — NEW: Von der Leyen: EU will not lift Russia sanctions until war ends; rules out resuming Russian gas purchases
